Editor.composer_formatting_toolbar_description: Enable the formatting toolbar in the message composer.
Editor.hide_add_menu_title: Hide Add Menu in the Editor
Editor.hide_add_menu_description: Make the Plus button in the editor only add files. You may still send the special items using commands such as /poll and /location
Editor.presence_status_description: Show and receive online status from other users.
Editor.reply_notifications_description: Disable to use silent replies by default. You can still toggle reply notifications for each reply.
Editor.individual_attachments_title: Send text with individual attachment as caption
Editor.individual_attachments_description: Send the contents of the message field as the attachment caption if present.

Gestures.enable_swiping_description: Swipe left for rooms, swipe right for actions.
Gestures.right_swipe_action_description: What happens when you swipe right on a message.

Calls.large_room_call_button_title: Show Call Button for Large Rooms
Calls.join_on_click_voicecalls_title: Join voice calls by just clicking the room's icon
Calls.incoming_call_sound_description: Play ringtone audio for incoming calls.
Calls.notify_voice_rooms_description: Play ringtone audio when someone starts or joins a voice room.
Calls.outgoing_ringback_sound_description: Play ringback while waiting for someone to join.
Calls.call_ringback_tone_description: Choose what plays while your outgoing call is waiting.
Calls.always_play_call_sound_description: Play call sounds even when message notification sounds are turned off.
Calls.custom_call_ringtone_description: Import an audio file for your ringtone.
Calls.custom_call_ringback_description: Import an audio file for outgoing ringback.
Calls.custom_ringtone_not_available: Custom ringtone is not available on this device. Falling back to default.
Calls.custom_ringback_not_available: Custom ringback is not available on this device. Falling back to default.
Calls.unable_to_preview_this_ringtone: Unable to preview this ringtone in your browser.
Calls.could_not_import_file_format: Could not import this file. Try a different audio format.
Calls.import_custom_ringtone_file: Import a custom ringtone file first.
Calls.import_custom_ringback_file: Import a custom ringback file first.
Calls.file_too_large: File is too large. Max {{maxSize}} allowed

Messages.disable_to_hide_redacted_messages_entire: Disable to hide redacted messages entirely instead of showing a tombstone.
Messages.enable_to_show_tombstone_events_for_reda: Enable to show tombstone events for redacted messages instead of hiding them entirely.
Messages.right_aligned_bubbles_description: While using bubble layout, have your bubbles right aligned.
Messages.hide_member_events_read_only_rooms_title: Hide Member Events in Read-Only Rooms
Messages.hide_member_events_read_only_rooms_descr: Hide membership changes, reactions, and reaction redactions in read-only rooms such as announcement channels.
Messages.show_hidden_events_description: Reveal additional timeline events that are normally filtered out.
Messages.show_hidden_events_enable: Enable to show hidden events, this will cause visual clutter in busy rooms.
Messages.hidden_event_edits_description: Show message edits as separate timeline events with a link to the previous version.
Messages.show_redacted_message_tombstones_descrip: Show a tombstone in place of redacted messages instead of hiding them entirely.
Messages.hidden_event_redaction_timeline_descript: Show when a message was redacted as a timeline event with a link to the original message.
Messages.hidden_event_reactions_description: Show reactions as separate timeline events with a link to the target message.
Messages.hidden_event_reaction_tombstones_descrip: Show a tombstone in place of redacted reactions instead of hiding them entirely.
Messages.hidden_event_reaction_redaction_timeline: Show when a reaction was removed as a timeline event with a link to the target message.
Messages.hidden_event_other_description: Show generic state events and other unrecognized timeline events.

Embeds.display_multiple_embeds_description: Display the embeds of all the links. Turning it off makes it only show the embed of the 1st item
Embeds.display_bundled_embeds_description: Show embeds when provided by the message itself. The embeds may be fabricated or incorrect.
Embeds.url_preview_description: Send the links from inside the messages to your homeserver to generate previews of the linked pages.
Embeds.encrypted_room_url_preview_description: Request server-side embeds in E2EE chats. This partially decreases secrecy by revealing sent links to your homeserver
Embeds.client_side_embeds_description: Attempt to preview supported urls (e.g. YouTube) on the client, without involving the homeserver. This will expose your IP Address to third party services.
Embeds.encrypted_room_embeds_disable: Disable client-side embeds in encrypted rooms
Embeds.encrypted_room_embeds_enable: Enable client-side embeds in encrypted rooms
Embeds.enable_gif_picker_description: Enables the gif picker in the emoji board. This reduces Privacy because it makes requests to klipy.com whenever you search for a gif.
Embeds.show_interactive_map_description: Show an interactive map in messages. This reduces Privacy because it requests map data from OpenStreetMap.org whenever you need to load a uncached part of the maps.
Embeds.show_interactive_map_enc_title: Show Interactive maps in Encrypted Rooms
Embeds.show_interactive_map_enc_description: Show an interactive map in Encrypted rooms. This reduces Privacy because it requests map data from OpenStreetMap.org whenever you need to load a uncached part of the maps.

Sync.use_sliding_sync_enable: Enable Sliding Sync for this current login/session. Requires server support and admin configuration.
Sync.use_sliding_sync_disable: Unavailable: the server has disabled Sliding Sync in its config.

SettingsSync.sync_across_devices_description: Store your settings in your Matrix account so they follow you to any Sable instance. Notification and zoom preferences are kept per-device.
SettingsSync.sync_across_devices_error: Sync failed, will retry on next change
SettingsSync.sync_across_devices_invalid: Could not import, file was invalid or you cancelled.

DiagnosticsAndPriivacy.error_reporting_send: Send anonymous crash reports to help improve Sable. No messages, room names, or personal data are included.
DiagnosticsAndPriivacy.error_reporting_unimplemented: Error reporting is not configured for this build.
DiagnosticsAndPriivacy.session_replay_description: Allow recording of UI interactions to help debug errors. All text, media, and inputs are fully masked before sending.
DiagnosticsAndPriivacy.please_refresh: Please refresh the page for these settings to take effect.
